market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $45,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: Question asks if BTC dips to $45,000 between Nov 24 2025 and Dec 31 2026. BTC is at $81,000 May 7 and has been rising from ~$63k 3 months ago. Would require ~44% drawdown from current levels by year-end. Historical bear-market drawdowns of that size happen but are uncommon mid-cycle. Time remaining ~8 months keeps possibility nonzero.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Macro shock or crypto-specific deleveraging could produce such a dip.
